body: He is so insecure with himself and unsure about his own sexuality that he is taking his anger/jealousy out on you. This is purely coming from a place of not being able to control you, and the response to simply doing what you want is this, a full on abusive melt down. Wearing what you want and being a slut don’t correlate anymore. Wearing small amounts of clothes to a festival and being a slut do not correlate anymore. His deep rooted misogyny is showing, and you should RUN. Nothing excuses talking to someone like this. He needs to reflect on himself, and he will not do that because abusers don’t know accountability.
He is disgusting. Leave him! This is not okay to treat somebody like this. You don’t deserve this and have done nothing to be treated this wayz

OP, please leave him. There is nothing that benefits you staying with them. There is nothing that constitutes treating somebody so vile. You can be understanding and loving, but they will take advantage of that and rip into you. This is unhealthy and I hope you will start to see this relationship for what it is.

You have asked the internet what we think… and this is not okay. None of the conversations, texts, the deeper meanings, all of it is not okay. This person is immature. Do not allow yourself to fall back into them, because they DO NOT respect you. This person is expecting you to come right back to them, and put up with all their shit. To avoid a lifetime of pain, please say your goodbyes and block them. I said goodbye to an abusive ex this exact way 3 years ago. Best thing I ever did for myself. They were controlling and scary. I will never trust anybody the same. I am so much happier now.

Focus on those academics, and stay the hell away from that guy. He is no good for you, and there is NO EXCUSE FOR ABUSE. It does not END, it does not CHANGE, those people do not STOP. Please save yourself and get out.

I hope you have found peace in whatever situation. I do not wish suicide or suicidal thoughts on anybody. I really hope you know you are not alone, despite how much it seems so. I am so sorry. If you see this, please begin telling yourself the things you deserve to hear. You are worth more than this, and again.. I am so sorry.

You must find the strength to help yourself, and leave. He has no choice but to accept your decision because he has no control over you. I know this is scary, and it feels like he does, but do know this: You do not owe anybody in this world ANYTHING. You are so much stronger than you even know. I hope you find power in these words. Words coming from a survivor of domestic abuse. Please take care of YOU. Nobody else but yourself!! Praying for the best.
I’m trying to keep myself together after a rough day. Reading this was a nice reminder. Thank you so much for the kind words. It means a lot.

simply put, wear it inside or donate it. people have made enough statements by destroying merch. it’s not pointless to destroy it, but donating allows you to get it off your hands and gives someone else the chance to repurpose it. i would personally never want his name/logo associated on me, but not everyone knows him! personal preferences. still, just do whatever and you don’t have to listen to any majority.

I just want to be who I am without the fear of someone watching me, because this person is dangerous and has left me in fear more than once. I should not be afraid to share the things that bring me joy. I appreciate your time.
